item.title: New Computer Laboratory Officially Opened
item.excerpt: A new, fully equipped computer laboratory will boost digital literacy for every learner.
item.body:
A new, fully equipped computer laboratory will boost digital literacy for every learner.

The school community continues to demonstrate its commitment to excellence. We thank our learners, staff and parents for their continued support.

More details will be shared through official school communication channels.
